title: Build and validate the optional whole-service Go cannon candidate

acceptance_criteria.description: Runnable whole-service Go cannon preserves frozen classic/event protocols, queue/Cassandra/presence effects, config and bounded operations.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: First runnable classic comparison then complete events implementation; exact final source/binary, original35 and frozen supplemental outcomes reviewed. Optional packaging/defaults and switchback verified separately before availability.

acceptance_criteria.description: Formatting, build, vet, race/security and dependency checks pass for the final candidate.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Actual pinned Go check output; meaningful generation/typed ack/input/TLS/concurrency regressions; no protected-oracle or Haskell-default changes.

handoff: Start runnable classic await/push/presence slice immediately using approved dependency pins; compare frozen HTTP/classic reference, then add RabbitMQ events and Cassandra recovery. Keep oracle immutable and preserve supported Haskell defaults.
